svg.aria-label: Architecture: CoinGecko API endpoints coins/markets and global, loaded by Python into raw Postgres tables coin_prices and global_market, cleaned by dbt staging views, modelled into dbt mart tables mart_daily_prices, mart_top_movers and mart_market_dominance, and served in Metabase. Apache Airflow runs ingest, dbt deps, dbt run, dbt test and a freshness check daily at 03:30 UTC.
svg.title: Architecture: CoinGecko API endpoints coins/markets and global, loaded by Python into raw Postgres tables coin_prices and global_market, cleaned by dbt staging views, modelled into dbt mart tables mart_daily_prices, mart_top_movers and mart_market_dominance, and served in Metabase. Apache Airflow runs ingest, dbt deps, dbt run, dbt test and a freshness check daily at 03:30 UTC.
